pageSpecField: nodes[].tokens (optional, closed): every slot holds a catalog token id of the category tokens/llm/token-catalog.json pageSpecSlots names; page-level `theme` must be a schema-validated theme from registry.manifest.json.

rules.TOKEN_UNKNOWN: a slot value that is not a token id in the catalog
rules.TOKEN_RAW_COLOR: a raw colour (hex, rgb(a), hsl(a), named CSS colour function) instead of a token id
rules.TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING: a raw length (px, rem, em, %, vh, vw, bare number) in a spacing slot (paddingTop / paddingBottom / gap) or any slot
rules.TOKEN_UNSUPPORTED_FONT: a fontFamily that is not in catalog.categories.fontFamily
rules.TOKEN_SLOT_MISMATCH: a catalog token of the wrong category / prefix for its slot (e.g. a layout token as `surface`)
rules.TOKEN_THEME_UNKNOWN: a page theme that is not one of registry.manifest.json schemaValidatedThemes
rules.TOKEN_THEME_UNRESOLVED: a colour / typography / radius / elevation token the declared theme file does not resolve
rules.TOKEN_INVALID_COMBINATION: a node whose text and surface tokens resolve (in the declared theme) to a contrast ratio below 3:1, e.g. text.inverse on surface.default

overrides.note: A node may pick catalog tokens for its slots; it can never carry raw values or style objects (the schema rejects `style`).

enforcement.catalogPolicyParity: machine-checked by extraction/verify_all.py (policy keys == catalog categories; catalog == fresh build from the token files)
enforcement.pageSpec: schema/semantic_validate.py TOKEN_* rules; adversarial suite covers each
